snippet.title: Time Takers - 1st CBT Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Step into the world of Time Takers, a trio-based time survival shooter where how you collect, spend, and control Time decides who survives.

Join the upcoming Closed Beta Test and be among the first to experience strategic combat, unique character abilities, and intense squad-based survival gameplay.

[CBT Details]
Region: North & South America 
(United States, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru)
Period: March 13 - March 21, 2026


[Stay Connected]
✅ Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596040/Time_Takers/
🔔 Subscribe for more: https://www.youtube.com/@timetakersgg
 
Follow Time Takers official channels for the latest news:
▶Discord: https://www.discord.gg/timetakers
▶X: https://www.x.com/timetakersgg
